findings.note: Smart's last five games (Nov 9–23) show 2, 1, 4, 2 and 3 assists in 17–25 minutes. Only two of those five cleared 2.5, and the Nov 3 note says he moved to the bench.

Smart's only start (Nov 1) came because Fred VanVleet was resting, and he was expected to return to the bench when VanVleet came back. Before that he missed games and was listed as questionable, so the upside depends on VanVleet's status, which I could not confirm for this game.
In the Nov 7 game against Phoenix (Suns won 102-99), the in-game box score showed Smart with 0 assists and 1-of-4 shooting late in the third quarter. This page does not show his final assist total.
